prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1436; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain. The reported injury pattern is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Over the course of 14 visits, care consisted of conservative management including physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and as-needed analgesia, and it followed a typical clinical progression with symptoms tapering as range of motion and function improved. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, supporting a soft tissue strain; however, neurological screening, reflexes, and straight leg raise testing were within normal limits. Review of the record also shows the patient was treated for the same body region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute to some of the current symptoms. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for services. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and return to activity as tolerated.
